item.text:
**New Evidence**
- Federal works ministries documented specific road completions and commissionings, which gives concrete but self-reported project completion evidence for 2022.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Welcome Address by The Permanent Secretary, Federal Ministry of Works and Housing, Bashir Nura Alkali, FCA, FCTI at The Commissioning and Handover of The Hadeija-Nguru Road, Phase II (Kirikasama-Nguru) in Jigawa State","publisher":"Federal Ministry of Works","publication_date":"2022-06-18","url":"https://www.fmw.gov.ng/read/2640","claim":"The ministry said it had successfully completed several roads and maintained several bridges, and that five roads had recently been commissioned by Mr. President as part of Buhari's developmental agenda.","locator":"paragraphs 3-6 of the speech excerpt","source_type":"official","source_confidence":"medium_high","source_confidence_reason":"Primary ministry speech with concrete project-completion claims, but it is self-reported and not independently audited.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"direct 2022 ruler-period project-completion evidence","ruler_attribution":"Attributed to Buhari's administration through the Works ministry; the claim reflects executive delivery but not independent audit.","contrary_evidence":["Self-report; it does not independently verify all claimed completions or the full priority-project portfolio."],"lenses":["8B.6","8B.7","8B.10"]}

- The annual federal budget implementation record shows weak execution relative to plan, which is the clearest audited-style indicator I found for 2022 macro implementation quality.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Q4 2022 Budget Implementation Report","publisher":"Policy Registry","publication_date":"unknown","url":"https://policyregistry.org/documents/q4-2022-bir/details","claim":"The report summary says actual aggregate revenue was N7.76 trillion, or 77.80% of the prorate target, and actual expenditure was N14.79 trillion, or 81.52% of the N18.14 trillion budget.","locator":"overview summary of the report","source_type":"other","source_confidence":"medium_high","source_confidence_reason":"Secondary index summarizing an official Budget Office report with specific figures; useful for implementation, but not the primary PDF itself.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"direct full-year 2022 execution evidence","ruler_attribution":"Partly attributable to Buhari's administration because it reflects federal fiscal execution, though some drivers were inherited and macroeconomic.","contrary_evidence":["It is a summary page, not the full official PDF, and it does not disaggregate sector-level completion."],"lenses":["8B.6","8B.7","8B.10"]}

- A World Bank completion report gives a concrete, independent outcome check for one major health-delivery project under the Buhari period.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Nigeria - Basic Healthcare Provision Fund Project","publisher":"World Bank","publication_date":"2022-05-20","url":"https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/448121655819922948","claim":"The project completion record rates outcome and Bank performance as satisfactory and says monitoring and evaluation quality was substantial.","locator":"document metadata and result summary on the report page","source_type":"IGO","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Independent completion-document metadata from the World Bank for a specific Nigerian health project.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"project-completion evidence within the 2022 ruler-period","ruler_attribution":"The project ran through Nigeria's federal health system during Buhari's tenure, but delivery responsibility was shared with implementing agencies and partners.","contrary_evidence":["This is project-specific, not a whole-administration evaluation, and it does not establish broad sector-wide success."],"lenses":["8B.6","8B.7"]}

- The federal delivery-tracking mechanism was formally launched in 2022, showing a concrete coordination instrument rather than rhetoric alone.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"FG inaugurates presidential delivery tracker, website","publisher":"The PUNCH","publication_date":"2022-08-30","url":"https://punchng.com/fg-inaugurates-presidential-delivery-tracker-website/","claim":"The Federal Government inaugurated the Presidential Delivery Tracker and said the PDT/CDCU was designed to track, review and periodically report MDA activities and ministerial performance in delivering mandates.","locator":"paragraphs 2-6","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Independent reporting on a specific launch, with clear description of the mechanism and its remit.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"direct 2022 coordination evidence","ruler_attribution":"Launched under Buhari's administration, but the item shows the mechanism's existence rather than its measured effect.","contrary_evidence":["Launch does not prove that the tracker improved implementation quality by year-end."],"lenses":["8B.2","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6"]}

- Independent reporting from the ministerial retreat shows both the existence of performance-management machinery and continuing implementation slippage.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Ministerial Retreat: Not the Typical Political Ritual","publisher":"Independent Newspaper Nigeria","publication_date":"2022-11-05","url":"https://independent.ng/ministerial-retreat-not-the-typical-political-ritual/","claim":"The article says some policy projects were yet to kickstart or were moving slower than expected, and that the retreat pushed ministries to reprioritize, set up mini delivery units, and improve target-setting, tracking and reporting.","locator":"opening and middle paragraphs summarizing the retreat and delivery reforms","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"medium","source_confidence_reason":"Independent newspaper summary of the retreat, useful for implementation frictions, but still largely paraphrases official remarks.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"late-2022 implementation and coordination evidence","ruler_attribution":"The retreat and delivery reforms were under Buhari's administration, but the article does not independently audit causal impact.","contrary_evidence":["The piece is mostly a recap of official claims, so it is weaker than an external audit of implementation outcomes."],"lenses":["8B.5","8B.8","8B.10"]}

**Gap Status**
- Audited completion data for major projects and service-delivery claims: partly resolved.
- The evidence now includes a full-year budget implementation summary, a World Bank project-completion record, and a ministry-level road-completion claim. That is enough to show real implementation and some measurable shortfall, but not a full audited portfolio review across the whole 2022 priority agenda.
- Independent evidence that coordination bodies and new appointments changed implementation quality: partly resolved, but not fully recoverable.
- The tracker launch, retreat process, and delivery-unit language show a concrete coordination architecture, while independent coverage also shows slippage and reprioritization pressure. What is still missing is a direct third-party evaluation linking those mechanisms to a measurable improvement in execution quality by end-2022.

**Search / Blockers**
- I searched official budget records, ministry project pages, World Bank project-completion material, and independent reporting on the 2022 ministerial retreat and delivery tracker.
- The main blocker was direct access to the underlying Budget Office PDF and the Policy Registry detail page, which were only partially accessible through indexed summaries.
- I did not find a clean third-party audit that ties the new coordination apparatus to a quantified improvement in delivery quality for the full 2022 portfolio.
